entries.label: module2_2023-11-30
entries.decision: Apply a precautionary approach regarding asymptomatic transmission.

entries.label: module2_2023-11-30

entries.evidence: I took the precautionary principle, in some cases overruling the scientific advice on the precautionary side. I mentioned, for instance, when we brought people back from Wuhan in late January, early February, the scientific advice from PHE was that they did not need to be quarantined and I overruled that and said that they needed to be quarantined, based on the precautionary principle.

I mentioned, for instance, when we brought people back from Wuhan in late January, early February, the scientific advice from PHE was that they did not need to be quarantined and I overruled that and said that they needed to be quarantined, based on the precautionary principle.
